rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red.
Registration name: HELkleger
Exhibition name: Super Elfin
rows.Bloom: Geranium-red. Strong fragrance. Small, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Occasional repeat later in the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Cut back one-half every year.. Do not dead head.
